objective: Test fold-related head-coordinate acceptance on a bounded released real-data subset; compare diagnosis and restart with physical-gradient auditing and cold starts. No claim of scene prevalence, denoising/SR superiority or hidden physical gradients.
selection: Fixed acquisition list, no solver outcomes inspected. DeepSfP and PolarNS: 128 seeded uniform eligible pixels plus 64 evenly spaced ranks among the top 1 percent observed DoLP, independently per image. Uniform and enriched strata reported separately. PolarBurstSR: each of 4 nominal color planes, fixed 4x4 sensor grid plus 8 enriched positions selected from the first frame only, all 14 frames. Overlap retained and disclosed.
eligibility: Finite nonnegative observations; all channels below 0.995; nominal S0 at least 5 percent of the sample/plane 99th percentile. DeepSfP additionally requires foreground mask.
units: DeepSfP stored normalized doubles; PolarNS img_mean/4096; PolarBurstSR PNG/65535. No per-pixel renormalization, clipping, synthetic noise or outcome-based selection.
reference: Exact ideal four-analyzer weighted cone minimum under W=diag(1,0.5,0.5); nominal linear instrument, not asserted full real-camera calibration or Poisson MLE.
initialization: First observation of each stream: [log(max(S0_LS,1e-6)),0.2,-0.1]; cold start recomputes this at every observation. Other arms carry their own preceding endpoint, including failures.
static_order: DeepSfP and PolarNS selected pixels are sorted in raster order, with separate streams per image/stratum. This is a prescribed spatial scan, not time or physical video motion.
temporal_order: PolarBurstSR follows recorded frame_00..13 at fixed sensor positions; no scene registration or fixed-material-point claim.
curvature_gate: Existing thresholds abs(r-1)<=1e-3 and c_r/I^2<-1e-7; one restart from best of existing point and radial offsets +/-0.01; same solver/options.
physical_gate: Reject physical supporting-half-space bound >1e-6; same restart. Physical auditing requires no Hessian.
scope: Bounded local CPU audit; no training, no new data acquisition, no adaptive grid expansion. Retain zeros and failures; incorporate findings with their scope into paper.
